lines.text: In a back alley behind the market the rain has stopped, but every gutter still drips in time. On an upturned crate a boy drums on a snare strapped to his belly.

lines.speaker: teun
lines.text: Trumpet kid! Jonas said you'd come! The Squad chased me off the docks, so I hid here. Ba-da-bam! Sorry. That one fell out by itself.

lines.speaker: pip
lines.text: Um. Hi. I'm Pip. Jonas said you were, um. Loud.

lines.speaker: teun
lines.text: Loudest in Port Murmur! Seven fines this month. The Squad keeps a drawer with my name on it.
A red coat steps out from between the crates, wet and unbothered. Ma Ruby, who left the Cellar over the back wall on a fish cart.

lines.speaker: ruby
lines.text: Keep it down, Teun. Half the harbor can hear you, and the other half wears a uniform. Jonas has my horn, so I'm in a good mood. Go with Pip.

lines.speaker: teun
lines.text: They say the Squad took Ma Ruby with the Cellar. She gave me my first sticks, you know.

lines.speaker: pip
lines.text: [I should say something. I say nothing. I am very good at it.]

lines.speaker: pip
lines.text: The Squad's vans are sweeping the market. Jonas keeps a safe place on the harbor, across town. We go by Tanner's Row and stay out of sight.

lines.speaker: teun
lines.text: Out of sight! Sure! One thing. If I stand still too long, my hands start. Eight seconds, maybe. Then, bam, parade.

lines.speaker: pip
lines.text: You can't stand still for eight seconds?

lines.speaker: teun
lines.text: Not on purpose! My hands just ask. Very loudly. Everybody says so.

lines.speaker: pip
lines.text: [Park him somewhere dark, for a few seconds only, and never near a policeman. I never planned to think that sentence.]
Far off, a whistle. Then another. The Quiet Squad's vans are crawling along the market streets.

lines.speaker: teun
lines.text: Is that for me? I'm going to be so quiet. Watch me. Watch me be quiet.

lines.speaker: pip
lines.text: [Two bad hiders and one snare drum. Easy.]
